import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

public final class TreeVariants {
    public static final class Node {
        public final int value;
        public Node left, right;
        public Node(int value) { this.value = value; }
    }
    private TreeVariants() {}
    private record Pair(Node a,Node b) {}
    /** Proper trees; compare both values and the complete null-aware shape. */
    public static boolean sameTree(Node a,Node b){
        Deque<Pair> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();stack.push(new Pair(a,b));
        while(!stack.isEmpty()){
            Pair pair=stack.pop();if(pair.a==null||pair.b==null){if(pair.a!=pair.b)return false;continue;}
            if(pair.a.value!=pair.b.value)return false;
            stack.push(new Pair(pair.a.right,pair.b.right));stack.push(new Pair(pair.a.left,pair.b.left));
        }
        return true;
    }
    /** Empty pattern is NOT a substructure under this interface's convention. */
    public static boolean isSubstructure(Node tree, Node pattern) {
        if (tree == null || pattern == null) return false;
        return matches(tree,pattern) || isSubstructure(tree.left,pattern) || isSubstructure(tree.right,pattern);
    }
    private static boolean matches(Node tree, Node pattern) {
        if (pattern == null) return true;
        return tree != null && tree.value == pattern.value && matches(tree.left,pattern.left) && matches(tree.right,pattern.right);
    }
    /** Ordinary proper binary tree; no preexisting parent pointers are required. */
    public static Optional<Node> lowestCommonAncestorIterative(Node root, Node p, Node q) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(p); Objects.requireNonNull(q);
        Map<Node,Node> parent = parentMap(root);
        if (!parent.containsKey(p) || !parent.containsKey(q)) return Optional.empty();
        Set<Node> ancestors = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
        for (Node x = p; x != null; x = parent.get(x)) ancestors.add(x);
        for (Node x = q; x != null; x = parent.get(x)) if (ancestors.contains(x)) return Optional.of(x);
        throw new AssertionError("connected tree invariant");
    }
    private static Map<Node,Node> parentMap(Node root) {
        Map<Node,Node> parent = new IdentityHashMap<>();
        Deque<Node> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
        if (root != null) { parent.put(root,null); queue.add(root); }
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            Node n = queue.remove();
            for (Node child : new Node[]{n.left,n.right}) if (child != null) {
                if (parent.containsKey(child)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("cycle or shared child");
                parent.put(child,n); queue.add(child);
            }
        }
        return parent;
    }
    private record PrefixFrame(Node node, long sum, boolean exit) {}
    /** Number of nonempty downward paths with arbitrary start/end. Proper-tree precondition. */
    public static long countDownwardPaths(Node root, long target) {
        Map<Long,Long> frequencies = new HashMap<>(); frequencies.put(0L,1L);
        Deque<PrefixFrame> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        if (root != null) stack.push(new PrefixFrame(root,0,false));
        long answer = 0;
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            PrefixFrame frame = stack.pop();
            if (frame.exit) {
                long count = frequencies.get(frame.sum) - 1;
                if (count == 0) frequencies.remove(frame.sum); else frequencies.put(frame.sum,count);
                continue;
            }
            long sum = Math.addExact(frame.sum,frame.node.value);
            try { answer = Math.addExact(answer, frequencies.getOrDefault(Math.subtractExact(sum,target),0L)); }
            catch (ArithmeticException e) {
                // If only the subtraction is outside long, no stored long prefix can match.
                if (!((target > 0 && sum < Long.MIN_VALUE + target) || (target < 0 && sum > Long.MAX_VALUE + target))) throw e;
            }
            frequencies.put(sum,Math.addExact(frequencies.getOrDefault(sum,0L),1));
            stack.push(new PrefixFrame(frame.node,sum,true));
            if (frame.node.right != null) stack.push(new PrefixFrame(frame.node.right,sum,false));
            if (frame.node.left != null) stack.push(new PrefixFrame(frame.node.left,sum,false));
        }
        return answer;
    }
    /** Full list of arbitrary-start downward paths. Duplicate value sequences retain multiplicity. */
    public static List<List<Integer>> allDownwardPaths(Node root, long target) {
        List<List<Integer>> out = new ArrayList<>();
        collect(root,target,new ArrayList<>(),out); return out;
    }
    private static void collect(Node n,long target,List<Integer> path,List<List<Integer>> out) {
        if (n == null) return;
        path.add(n.value); long sum = 0;
        for (int start = path.size()-1; start >= 0; start--) {
            sum = Math.addExact(sum,path.get(start));
            if (sum == target) out.add(List.copyOf(path.subList(start,path.size())));
        }
        collect(n.left,target,path,out); collect(n.right,target,path,out); path.remove(path.size()-1);
    }
    /** Unlike BST kth-smallest, this visits every node. Repeated values occupy repeated ranks. */
    public static int kthSmallestOrdinaryTree(Node root,int k) {
        if (k < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("positive k");
        PriorityQueue<Integer> largest = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.reverseOrder());
        Deque<Node> stack = new ArrayDeque<>(); if (root != null) stack.push(root);
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            Node n = stack.pop();
            if (largest.size() < k) largest.add(n.value);
            else if (n.value < largest.element()) { largest.remove(); largest.add(n.value); }
            if(n.left!=null)stack.push(n.left); if(n.right!=null)stack.push(n.right);
        }
        if(largest.size()<k)throw new IllegalArgumentException("k exceeds node count");
        return largest.element();
    }
    private record Box(Node node) {}
    public static String serialize(Node root) {
        Set<Node> seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
        Deque<Box> stack = new ArrayDeque<>(); stack.push(new Box(root)); StringJoiner out = new StringJoiner(" ");
        while(!stack.isEmpty()) {
            Node n=stack.pop().node;
            if(n==null){out.add("#");continue;}
            if(!seen.add(n))throw new IllegalArgumentException("cycle or shared child");
            out.add(Integer.toString(n.value)); stack.push(new Box(n.right)); stack.push(new Box(n.left));
        }
        return out.toString();
    }
    private static final class Children { final Node node; int next; Children(Node node){this.node=node;} }
    public static Node deserialize(String text) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(text);
        StringTokenizer tokens=new StringTokenizer(text);
        if(!tokens.hasMoreTokens())throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty encoding");
        Node root=parseNode(tokens.nextToken()); Deque<Children> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();
        if(root!=null)stack.push(new Children(root));
        while(tokens.hasMoreTokens()) {
            if(stack.isEmpty())throw new IllegalArgumentException("extra token");
            Children parent=stack.peek(); Node child=parseNode(tokens.nextToken());
            if(parent.next++==0)parent.node.left=child;else parent.node.right=child;
            if(parent.next==2)stack.pop();
            if(child!=null)stack.push(new Children(child));
        }
        if(!stack.isEmpty())throw new IllegalArgumentException("truncated encoding");
        return root;
    }
    private static Node parseNode(String token) { return token.equals("#")?null:new Node(Integer.parseInt(token)); }
    public static final class NNode {
        public final String id;
        public final List<NNode> children=new ArrayList<>();
        public NNode(String id){this.id=Objects.requireNonNull(id);}
    }
    /** Unique IDs; result is target -> parent -> ... -> root, or empty if absent. */
    public static List<String> pathToRoot(NNode root,String id) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(id);if(root==null)return List.of();
        Map<String,NNode> ids=new HashMap<>();Map<NNode,NNode> parent=new IdentityHashMap<>();
        Deque<NNode> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();queue.add(root);parent.put(root,null);
        while(!queue.isEmpty()) {
            NNode n=queue.remove();if(ids.putIfAbsent(n.id,n)!=null)throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate id");
            for(NNode child:n.children) {
                Objects.requireNonNull(child);
                if(parent.containsKey(child))throw new IllegalArgumentException("cycle or shared child");
                parent.put(child,n);queue.add(child);
            }
        }
        List<String> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(NNode n=ids.get(id);n!=null;n=parent.get(n))out.add(n.id);
        return out;
    }
    /** ACM demonstration protocol: one complete preorder encoding per line, until EOF. */
    public static void solve(Reader input,Writer output)throws IOException {
        BufferedReader in=input instanceof BufferedReader b?b:new BufferedReader(input);
        for(String line;(line=in.readLine())!=null;) {output.write(serialize(deserialize(line)));output.write('\n');}
        output.flush();
    }
    public static void main(String[] args)throws IOException {
        if(args.length!=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("use stdin");
        solve(new InputStreamReader(System.in,StandardCharsets.UTF_8),new OutputStreamWriter(System.out,StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
}

树的遍历、递归返回值与基础十七题

树题先说清“这一棵子树要交回什么”，再决定当前节点在前序、中序还是后序工作。下面十七题可按三组理解：遍历和有序查询，构造与原地改树，组合子树结果；代码共用 TreeCore.TreeNode，完整类在本章后半部。

n 为节点数，h 为树高，w 为最大层宽；除另行说明外，输入是真正的二叉树，不含环和共享子节点。辅助空间与结果空间分开说明。“平均 O(log n)”不能直接套到未保证平衡的树上。

二叉树的扩展题怎样复用返回状态

先定义“这一层返回给父节点的是什么”，树题就能从遍历扩展到路径、构造和树形动态规划。TreeCore 的前提是无环、无共享子树的有限树；递归方案占 O(h) 栈，极深链式树应改显式栈，不能把递归栈忽略成 O(1)。

层序及其变体

层序遍历在每轮开始固定本层队列大小，处理恰好这些节点，再进入下一层；把各层组成的外层列表整体反转，层内仍保持从左到右，就得到自底向上层序。右视图取每层最后一个，左下角取最后一层第一个，层最大值和均值对本层聚合，N 叉树把两个孩子改为孩子列表。空树返回空集合，空树左下角返回 OptionalInt.empty。均值先用 long 累加再除以节点数。当前 levelAverages/levelMaxima 复用完整层序，实际辅助空间为 O(n)，不能只报 O(w) 队列；可以单层累计降低到 O(w)。

前序迭代先压右再压左；后序迭代用 last 记录刚完成的子树，只有右子树不存在或已处理时才访问栈顶。三种遍历都 O(n) 时间，显式栈 O(h)，结果 O(n)。

填充 next 指针可以用已经建立的上一层 next 链扫描本层，用 dummy/tail 串起下一层。每层收尾显式置 null，先清根的旧 next，防止复用带脏指针的树形成环。峰值辅助 O(1)，但示例每层创建一个 dummy，总分配 O(h) 个对象；如果在意总分配，可复用一个哨兵。该算法不要求完美二叉树。

深度、节点数、路径和与左叶子

最小深度是到最近叶子的节点数，单侧为空时不能取 min(0,非空深度)+1；BFS 第一次弹出叶子即可返回。完全二叉树计数利用左右最外路径高度：相等说明子树是满树，可直接计算 2^h-1，否则递归两侧。只有“完全”前提成立才能用这条推断，任意树两边高度相等并不够。复杂度 O(log²n)，递归 O(logn)，结果为 long；极端高度超接口可表示范围时明确拒绝。

所有根到叶路径共享同一条可回退 path，遇叶子才输出；总耗时应按所有输出路径总长度计算。路径总和只承认根到叶的路径，不能在中间节点累计恰好命中时提前接受。负值允许，所以不能用“当前和已经超过目标”剪枝。hasPathSum 返回布尔，pathSum 返回所有路径；累计 long，异常超界用精确加法处理。

左叶子必须同时满足“是左孩子”和“没有孩子”。根本身不是左叶子；普通左孩子若还有子树，也不能把它自身值加入左叶子之和。

最大二叉树、合并与BST维护

最大二叉树的单调栈保持从根候选到右链的值不增，新值弹出的较小节点组成它的左子树，栈顶剩余节点把它作为右子树。每个元素最多进出一次，O(n)/O(n)。重复最大值采用左侧较早者为祖先的规则，构造后中序必须与原数组完全相同。

合并两棵树按对应位置加值，缺失位置视为 0；本节创建全新节点，不让结果与任一输入共享可变节点，O(n+m) 上界。int 节点值相加超界抛异常。若题目要求原地合并，要明确结果会共享或修改哪棵树，不能直接把此处空间说成 O(1)。

BST 搜索和插入沿比较结果走一侧，插入重复值按严格 BST 合同忽略；删除有两个孩子的节点时用右子树最小值替换，再在右子树删除该值。删除会修改节点值，因此保留旧节点引用的调用方可能看到值改变，不能承诺“删除后其他节点身份和值全都不变”。修剪闭区间 [low,high] 时，值低于 low 的节点及其左子树都不可能保留，值高于 high 对称处理。

搜索、插入和删除单次 O(h)，未平衡 BST 的 h 可达 n。修剪需要访问所有可能保留的节点，最坏 O(n) 时间、O(h) 递归栈；即使树平衡，区间覆盖全树时也会访问全部节点。最小绝对差和众数利用中序非递减顺序，允许重复值时最小差可以为 0；少于两个节点没有差值，返回空 OptionalLong。众数用连续相同值的 run，频次更大时清空结果，相同时追加。与严格 BST 验证拒绝重复值的合同不同，应按具体题切换。

树上最少摄像头

后序让孩子先告诉父节点是否已经被覆盖，再在必要时放摄像头。空节点返回“已覆盖”；任一孩子未覆盖，当前放摄像头；否则任一孩子有摄像头，当前已覆盖；否则当前未覆盖。根最后若仍未覆盖，再加一个摄像头。把摄像头放在未覆盖孩子的父节点，至少覆盖孩子本来需要覆盖的范围，并可能覆盖父节点及另一个孩子，故不会比放在孩子更差。O(n) 时间，O(h) 栈。

展开树的常数空间变体

若当前有左子树，找到左子树的最右节点，把原右子树接到该节点右侧，再把左子树搬到当前右侧并清空左指针；沿右指针继续。这样保留前序顺序，不创建结果节点。总重连扫描 O(n)，额外 O(1)；遍历过的边不会因为找前驱而反复跨越任意多个祖先。与反向前序递归实现的 O(h) 栈相比，这个变体改变了辅助空间合同。

import java.util.*;
public final class TreeCore {

public static class TreeNode {
    int val;
    TreeNode left, right, next;
    TreeNode(int val) { this.val = val; }
}

static List<List<Integer>> traversals(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> pre = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> in = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Integer> post = new ArrayList<>();
    dfsOrders(root, pre, in, post);
    return Arrays.asList(pre, in, post);
}
static void dfsOrders(TreeNode n, List<Integer> pre,
                      List<Integer> in, List<Integer> post) {
    if (n == null) return; // 空子树贡献空序列
    pre.add(n.val);        // 先根，再左右
    dfsOrders(n.left, pre, in, post);
    in.add(n.val);         // 左子树结束，访问根
    dfsOrders(n.right, pre, in, post);
    post.add(n.val);       // 两个子树结束，访问根
}

static List<Integer> inorderTraversal(TreeNode root) {
    List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
    Deque<TreeNode> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
    TreeNode cur = root;
    while (cur != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
        while (cur != null) {
            stack.push(cur); // 回头再处理这个根
            cur = cur.left;
        }
        cur = stack.pop();
        out.add(cur.val);
        cur = cur.right;    // 右子树也按相同规则处理
    }
    return out;
}

static boolean isValidBST(TreeNode root) {
    return checkBST(root, Long.MIN_VALUE, Long.MAX_VALUE);
}
static boolean checkBST(TreeNode n, long low, long high) {
    if (n == null) return true;
    if (n.val <= low || n.val >= high) return false;
    return checkBST(n.left, low, n.val)
        && checkBST(n.right, n.val, high);
}

static int kthSmallest(TreeNode root, int k) {
    if (k <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("k must be positive");
    Deque<TreeNode> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
    TreeNode cur = root;
    while (cur != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
        while (cur != null) {
            stack.push(cur);
            cur = cur.left;
        }
        cur = stack.pop();
        if (--k == 0) return cur.val; // 访问计数，不是入栈计数
        cur = cur.right;
    }
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("k exceeds tree size");
}

static TreeNode lowestCommonAncestorBST(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q) {
    if (p == null || q == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null target");
    int low = Math.min(p.val, q.val), high = Math.max(p.val, q.val);
    TreeNode cur = root;
    while (cur != null) {
        if (cur.val < low) cur = cur.right;
        else if (cur.val > high) cur = cur.left;
        else return cur; // 包含等号：某目标可以是另一个的祖先
    }
    return null;
}

static TreeNode buildTree(int[] pre, int[] in) {
    if (pre == null || in == null || pre.length != in.length)
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("incompatible arrays");
    Map<Integer, Integer> index = new HashMap<>();
    for (int i = 0; i < in.length; i++) {
        if (index.put(in[i], i) != null)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate value");
    }
    return buildPart(pre, 0, 0, in.length, index);
}
static TreeNode buildPart(int[] pre, int preStart, int inL, int inR,
                          Map<Integer, Integer> index) {
    if (inL == inR) return null;
    if (preStart >= pre.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid preorder");
    int value = pre[preStart];
    Integer mid = index.get(value);
    if (mid == null || mid < inL || mid >= inR)
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("inconsistent traversals");
    int leftSize = mid - inL;
    TreeNode root = new TreeNode(value);
    root.left = buildPart(pre, preStart + 1, inL, mid, index);
    root.right = buildPart(pre, preStart + 1 + leftSize, mid + 1, inR, index);
    return root;
}

static int maxPathSum(TreeNode root) {
    if (root == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("nonempty tree required");
    long[] best = {Long.MIN_VALUE}; // 每次调用独立，支持重复调用
    pathGain(root, best);
    return Math.toIntExact(best[0]);
}
static long pathGain(TreeNode n, long[] best) {
    if (n == null) return 0;
    long left = Math.max(0L, pathGain(n.left, best));
    long right = Math.max(0L, pathGain(n.right, best));
    best[0] = Math.max(best[0], (long)n.val + left + right);
    return n.val + Math.max(left, right); // 返回值只能是一条单链
}

static int maxDepth(TreeNode root) {
    if (root == null) return 0;
    int left = maxDepth(root.left);
    int right = maxDepth(root.right);
    return Math.max(left, right) + 1;
}

static TreeNode lowestCommonAncestor(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q) {
    if (root == null || root == p || root == q) return root;
    TreeNode left = lowestCommonAncestor(root.left, p, q);
    TreeNode right = lowestCommonAncestor(root.right, p, q);
    if (left != null && right != null) return root;
    return left != null ? left : right;
}
// 目标存在性不受保证时使用此入口；按引用核验，不按数值。
static TreeNode lcaIfBothExist(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q) {
    if (p == null || q == null || !containsNode(root, p) || !containsNode(root, q))
        return null;
    return lowestCommonAncestor(root, p, q);
}
static boolean containsNode(TreeNode root, TreeNode target) {
    return root != null && (root == target || containsNode(root.left, target)
                                            || containsNode(root.right, target));
}

static List<List<Integer>> levelOrder(TreeNode root) {
    List<List<Integer>> out = new ArrayList<>();
    if (root == null) return out;
    Deque<TreeNode> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    queue.offer(root);
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int size = queue.size(); // 固定本层数量
        List<Integer> level = new ArrayList<>(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            TreeNode n = queue.poll();
            level.add(n.val);
            if (n.left != null) queue.offer(n.left);
            if (n.right != null) queue.offer(n.right);
        }
        out.add(level);
    }
    return out;
}

static TreeNode sortedArrayToBST(int[] nums) {
    if (nums == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null array");
    return balancedPart(nums, 0, nums.length);
}
static TreeNode balancedPart(int[] a, int left, int right) {
    if (left >= right) return null;
    int mid = left + (right - left) / 2; // 不用 (left+right)/2
    TreeNode n = new TreeNode(a[mid]);
    n.left = balancedPart(a, left, mid);
    n.right = balancedPart(a, mid + 1, right);
    return n;
}

static void flatten(TreeNode root) {
    TreeNode[] prev = {null}; // 当前已经建好的右链头
    flattenReverse(root, prev);
}
static void flattenReverse(TreeNode n, TreeNode[] prev) {
    if (n == null) return;
    flattenReverse(n.right, prev);
    flattenReverse(n.left, prev);
    n.right = prev[0];
    n.left = null;
    prev[0] = n;
}

static TreeNode invertTree(TreeNode root) {
    if (root == null) return null;
    TreeNode left = invertTree(root.left);
    TreeNode right = invertTree(root.right);
    root.left = right;
    root.right = left;
    return root;
}

static int diameterOfBinaryTree(TreeNode root) {
    int[] best = {0};
    diameterHeight(root, best);
    return best[0];
}
static int diameterHeight(TreeNode n, int[] best) {
    if (n == null) return 0;
    int left = diameterHeight(n.left, best);
    int right = diameterHeight(n.right, best);
    best[0] = Math.max(best[0], left + right); // 边数
    return Math.max(left, right) + 1;         // 节点数高度
}

static TreeNode convertBST(TreeNode root) {
    long[] sum = {0};
    addGreater(root, sum);
    return root;
}
static void addGreater(TreeNode n, long[] sum) {
    if (n == null) return;
    addGreater(n.right, sum);
    sum[0] += n.val; // n 此时仍是原值
    n.val = Math.toIntExact(sum[0]);
    addGreater(n.left, sum);
}

static int rob(TreeNode root) {
    long[] state = robState(root);
    return Math.toIntExact(Math.max(state[0], state[1]));
}
static long[] robState(TreeNode n) {
    if (n == null) return new long[]{0, 0};
    long[] left = robState(n.left), right = robState(n.right);
    long skip = Math.max(left[0], left[1]) + Math.max(right[0], right[1]);
    long take = n.val + left[0] + right[0];
    return new long[]{skip, take}; // 约定顺序固定为不选、选
}

static boolean isSubtree(TreeNode root, TreeNode subRoot) {
    if (subRoot == null) return true;
    if (root == null) return false;
    return sameTree(root, subRoot) || isSubtree(root.left, subRoot)
                                  || isSubtree(root.right, subRoot);
}
static boolean sameTree(TreeNode a, TreeNode b) {
    if (a == null || b == null) return a == b;
    return a.val == b.val && sameTree(a.left, b.left) && sameTree(a.right, b.right);
}

    /** 根到最近叶子的节点数；只有一个孩子时不能把空孩子当作最近叶。 */
    static int minDepth(TreeNode root) {
        if (root == null) return 0;
        ArrayDeque<TreeNode> queue = new ArrayDeque<>(); queue.add(root);
        for (int depth = 1; !queue.isEmpty(); depth++) {
            for (int count = queue.size(); count > 0; count--) {
                TreeNode node = queue.remove();
                if (node.left == null && node.right == null) return depth;
                if (node.left != null) queue.add(node.left);
                if (node.right != null) queue.add(node.right);
            }
        }
        throw new AssertionError();
    }
    /** 前提：完全二叉树。返回 long，不能把任意树的两端同高误当作满树。 */
    static long countComplete(TreeNode root) {
        if (root == null) return 0;
        int left = 0, right = 0;
        for (TreeNode p = root; p != null; p = p.left) left++;
        for (TreeNode p = root; p != null; p = p.right) right++;
        if (left == right) {
            if (left > 63) throw new ArithmeticException("node count exceeds long");
            if (left == 63) return Long.MAX_VALUE;
            return (1L << left) - 1;
        }
        return Math.addExact(1, Math.addExact(countComplete(root.left), countComplete(root.right)));
    }
    static List<String> binaryTreePaths(TreeNode root) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>(); collectPaths(root, new ArrayList<>(), out); return out;
    }
    private static void collectPaths(TreeNode node, List<Integer> path, List<String> out) {
        if (node == null) return;
        path.add(node.val);
        if (node.left == null && node.right == null) {
            StringJoiner joined = new StringJoiner("->");
            for (int value : path) joined.add(Integer.toString(value));
            out.add(joined.toString());
        } else { collectPaths(node.left, path, out); collectPaths(node.right, path, out); }
        path.remove(path.size() - 1);
    }
    static long sumLeftLeaves(TreeNode root) {
        if (root == null) return 0;
        long answer = 0;
        if (root.left != null && root.left.left == null && root.left.right == null) answer += root.left.val;
        else answer += sumLeftLeaves(root.left);
        return answer + sumLeftLeaves(root.right);
    }
    static OptionalInt bottomLeft(TreeNode root) {
        if (root == null) return OptionalInt.empty();
        ArrayDeque<TreeNode> queue = new ArrayDeque<>(); queue.add(root); int answer = root.val;
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            answer = queue.peek().val;
            for (int count = queue.size(); count > 0; count--) {
                TreeNode node = queue.remove();
                if (node.left != null) queue.add(node.left);
                if (node.right != null) queue.add(node.right);
            }
        }
        return OptionalInt.of(answer);
    }
    static boolean hasPathSum(TreeNode root, long target) {
        return hasPath(root, target, 0L);
    }
    private static boolean hasPath(TreeNode node, long target, long prefix) {
        if (node == null) return false;
        long sum = Math.addExact(prefix, node.val);
        if (node.left == null && node.right == null) return sum == target;
        return hasPath(node.left, target, sum) || hasPath(node.right, target, sum);
    }
    static List<List<Integer>> pathSum(TreeNode root, long target) {
        List<List<Integer>> out = new ArrayList<>(); pathSumVisit(root, 0L, target, new ArrayList<>(), out); return out;
    }
    private static void pathSumVisit(TreeNode node, long prefix, long target, List<Integer> path, List<List<Integer>> out) {
        if (node == null) return;
        long sum = Math.addExact(prefix, node.val); path.add(node.val);
        if (node.left == null && node.right == null && sum == target) out.add(new ArrayList<>(path));
        pathSumVisit(node.left, sum, target, path, out); pathSumVisit(node.right, sum, target, path, out);
        path.remove(path.size() - 1);
    }
    /** 最大笛卡尔树：中序等于输入；相等时靠左元素先作祖先。 */
    static TreeNode maximumBinaryTree(int[] values) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(values); ArrayDeque<TreeNode> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int value : values) {
            TreeNode node = new TreeNode(value);
            while (!stack.isEmpty() && stack.peek().val < value) node.left = stack.pop();
            if (!stack.isEmpty()) stack.peek().right = node;
            stack.push(node);
        }
        return stack.peekLast();
    }
    /** 结果不与两输入共享节点，节点和超出 int 时明确失败。 */
    static TreeNode mergeTreesCopy(TreeNode first, TreeNode second) {
        if (first == null && second == null) return null;
        TreeNode node = new TreeNode(Math.addExact(first == null ? 0 : first.val, second == null ? 0 : second.val));
        node.left = mergeTreesCopy(first == null ? null : first.left, second == null ? null : second.left);
        node.right = mergeTreesCopy(first == null ? null : first.right, second == null ? null : second.right);
        return node;
    }
    static TreeNode searchBST(TreeNode root, int value) {
        while (root != null && root.val != value) root = value < root.val ? root.left : root.right;
        return root;
    }
    static OptionalLong minimumDifference(TreeNode root) {
        ArrayDeque<TreeNode> stack = new ArrayDeque<>(); TreeNode node = root;
        boolean seen = false; long previous = 0, best = Long.MAX_VALUE; int count = 0;
        while (node != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
            while (node != null) { stack.push(node); node = node.left; }
            node = stack.pop(); if (seen) best = Math.min(best, (long) node.val - previous);
            previous = node.val; seen = true; count++; node = node.right;
        }
        return count < 2 ? OptionalLong.empty() : OptionalLong.of(best);
    }
    /** 允许相等键的 BST，只要求中序非递减。 */
    static List<Integer> modes(TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> answer = new ArrayList<>(); ArrayDeque<TreeNode> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        TreeNode node = root; int previous = 0, run = 0, best = 0; boolean seen = false;
        while (node != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
            while (node != null) { stack.push(node); node = node.left; }
            node = stack.pop(); run = seen && previous == node.val ? run + 1 : 1;
            if (run > best) { best = run; answer.clear(); }
            if (run == best) answer.add(node.val);
            previous = node.val; seen = true; node = node.right;
        }
        return answer;
    }
    /** 严格 BST，重复 key 不插入。 */
    static TreeNode insertBST(TreeNode root, int value) {
        if (root == null) return new TreeNode(value);
        TreeNode node = root;
        while (true) {
            if (value == node.val) return root;
            if (value < node.val) { if (node.left == null) { node.left = new TreeNode(value); return root; } node = node.left; }
            else { if (node.right == null) { node.right = new TreeNode(value); return root; } node = node.right; }
        }
    }
    /** 原地删除一个 key；两孩子时用中序后继值替换，节点值身份会改变。 */
    static TreeNode deleteBST(TreeNode root, int value) {
        if (root == null) return null;
        if (value < root.val) root.left = deleteBST(root.left, value);
        else if (value > root.val) root.right = deleteBST(root.right, value);
        else {
            if (root.left == null) return root.right;
            if (root.right == null) return root.left;
            TreeNode successor = root.right; while (successor.left != null) successor = successor.left;
            root.val = successor.val; root.right = deleteBST(root.right, successor.val);
        }
        return root;
    }
    static TreeNode trimBST(TreeNode root, int low, int high) {
        if (low > high) throw new IllegalArgumentException("range");
        if (root == null) return null;
        if (root.val < low) return trimBST(root.right, low, high);
        if (root.val > high) return trimBST(root.left, low, high);
        root.left = trimBST(root.left, low, high); root.right = trimBST(root.right, low, high); return root;
    }
    static List<List<Integer>> levelOrderBottom(TreeNode root) {
        List<List<Integer>> result = levelOrder(root); Collections.reverse(result); return result;
    }
    static List<Double> levelAverages(TreeNode root) {
        List<Double> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<Integer> level : levelOrder(root)) { long sum = 0; for (int value : level) sum += value; result.add((double) sum / level.size()); }
        return result;
    }
    static List<Integer> levelMaxima(TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<Integer> level : levelOrder(root)) result.add(Collections.max(level));
        return result;
    }
    static final class NNode {
        final int value; final List<NNode> children = new ArrayList<>(); NNode(int value) { this.value = value; }
    }
    static List<List<Integer>> naryLevelOrder(NNode root) {
        List<List<Integer>> result = new ArrayList<>(); if (root == null) return result;
        ArrayDeque<NNode> queue = new ArrayDeque<>(); queue.add(root);
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) { List<Integer> level = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int count = queue.size(); count > 0; count--) { NNode node = queue.remove(); level.add(node.value); for (NNode child : node.children) queue.add(Objects.requireNonNull(child)); }
            result.add(level);
        }
        return result;
    }
    /** 普通二叉树也适用；逐层使用 next，额外指针为常数。 */
    static void connectNext(TreeNode root) {
        if (root == null) return; root.next = null;
        for (TreeNode level = root; level != null;) {
            TreeNode dummy = new TreeNode(0), tail = dummy;
            for (TreeNode node = level; node != null; node = node.next) {
                if (node.left != null) { tail.next = node.left; tail = tail.next; }
                if (node.right != null) { tail.next = node.right; tail = tail.next; }
            }
            tail.next = null; level = dummy.next;
        }
    }
    static int minCameras(TreeNode root) {
        int[] count = {0}; int state = cameraState(root, count); return count[0] + (state == 0 ? 1 : 0);
    }
    // 0 未覆盖；1 当前有摄像头；2 已被孩子摄像头覆盖。空节点按已覆盖处理。
    private static int cameraState(TreeNode node, int[] count) {
        if (node == null) return 2;
        int left = cameraState(node.left, count), right = cameraState(node.right, count);
        if (left == 0 || right == 0) { count[0]++; return 1; }
        return left == 1 || right == 1 ? 2 : 0;
    }
    static void flattenConstantSpace(TreeNode root) {
        for (TreeNode node = root; node != null; node = node.right) {
            if (node.left == null) continue;
            TreeNode predecessor = node.left; while (predecessor.right != null) predecessor = predecessor.right;
            predecessor.right = node.right; node.right = node.left; node.left = null;
        }
    }


    static List<Integer> preorderIterative(TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>(); if (root == null) return result;
        Deque<TreeNode> stack = new ArrayDeque<>(); stack.push(root);
        while (!stack.isEmpty()) { TreeNode node = stack.pop(); result.add(node.val); if (node.right != null) stack.push(node.right); if (node.left != null) stack.push(node.left); }
        return result;
    }
    static List<Integer> postorderIterative(TreeNode root) {
        List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>(); Deque<TreeNode> stack = new ArrayDeque<>(); TreeNode at = root, last = null;
        while (at != null || !stack.isEmpty()) {
            if (at != null) { stack.push(at); at = at.left; }
            else { TreeNode node = stack.peek(); if (node.right != null && last != node.right) at = node.right; else { result.add(node.val); last = stack.pop(); } }
        }
        return result;
    }
}
